newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Kekkuti to begin trade on Hungary bourse on Dec 2.
newsitem.headline: Kekkuti to begin trade on Hungary bourse on Dec 2.

text.p: The Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) said on Thursday that trading in the shares of mineral water producer Kekkuti Rt on the BSE would start on December 2, in the automatic trading system.
The BSE said in its official gazette that it had listed 2,359,260 Kekkuti shares, each having a face value of 100 forints.
Of the package, 23,260 shares, which come from a capital increase and entitle the holder to a dividend from September 23 this year, will have a distinguishing mark in trading, the BSE said.
